result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's `*Scoping*` tests pass. I did not add new tests, so the new matches (`.htm` pages, `<doc>` XML, `build-gradle.js`) are not checked directly.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, which listed `html` twice. They are now `(html|htm|xhtml)`.
- **`// Generated by …` JS and `<doc>` XML:** the file patterns `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml` only matched a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** the pattern `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so any `*-gradle.js` file matches.

Ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still stay out of these scopes, because the content patterns are unchanged.
